5. REMOVE FLOW CONTROL VALVE AND SPRING
Remove the pressure port union, and remove the valve and spring.

6. REMOVE FLOW CONTROL SPRING SEAT
(a) Using snap ring pliers, remove the snap ring.

(b) Temporarily install a bolt and pull out the seat.

7. REMOVE REAR HOUSING
(a) Place matchmarks on the front and rear housings.
(b) Remove the four bolts and rear housing.

8. REMOVE REAR SIDE PLATE
(a) Using a plastic hammer, tap the rotor shaft.
(b) Remove the rear side plate.
(c) Remove the three O-rings.
